protocol: autonomous_goal_generation_v2: Block-4 minimal experiment. No external task: goals emerge from the belief system's confidence gaps. Half the domains have prior knowledge (low gap), half are unknown (high gap). Criterion: gap_goals completes all domains (coverage >= 0.95), its first goal is an unknown high-gap domain in >= 80% of episodes, and beats random's first-goal quality by >= 0.2 -- goals come from internal gaps, not the task.
